title: Connector shipment
passage:
Did the connector supplier confirm the shipping date?
A. The connection is wireless.
B. Shipping boxes are brown.
C. They promised to confirm it this afternoon.
passageZh:
連接器供應商有確認出貨日期嗎？
A. 這個連線是無線的。
B. 運輸紙箱是棕色的。
C. 他們答應今天下午確認。
